Item_Diary_Desc: A blank notebook found in your sister's room. Collected pages can be kept inside.
Doc_Sample01_Body:
If you are reading this, I am no longer in this house.

Stay out of the basement, at least at night. The bulb down there lights up by itself every midnight, though the switch is always off. I pulled the fuse once; it was lit again the next day.

I wrote down everything I could in the notebook: the bells, the footsteps, the shadows under the door. They always come at the same time, as if someone is keeping to a schedule.

The key is in the usual place. You know where: under the tree where we buried the marbles when we were kids.

Once you have the key, go to the attic first. There is a map in the chest up there with three places marked. Visit them in order and skip none.

And no matter who calls your name, do not look back.

- R

Doc_Sample02_Body: Day three. The bell outside rang thirteen times again. I took this photo under the clock tower. No one believes me, but I am sure that clock tower stopped years ago.
